header.title: Genre Foundation Library
header.description: Maintain reusable genre positioning and category hierarchies for novels. When starting a book, pick a suitable genre foundation so the AI understands the work's type, reader expectations and main creative direction.

genres.label: Genre foundations
genres.detail: Category nodes a novel can choose from

roots.label: Root categories
roots.detail: Used to divide the main creative directions

descriptions.label: Descriptions complete
descriptions.detail: Genres with a clear positioning description

delete.confirmWithChildren_one: Delete genre foundation “{{name}}”? This also deletes its {{count}} sub-category and cannot be undone.
delete.confirmWithChildren_other: Delete genre foundation “{{name}}”? This also deletes its {{count}} sub-categories and cannot be undone.
delete.confirm: Delete genre foundation “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.

recommendation.errorDescription: The genre structure cannot be read right now. After reloading you can continue to view, edit and maintain genres.
recommendation.loadingDescription: Once loaded, next-step suggestions will be based on genre coverage and description completeness.
recommendation.emptyTitle: Build your first genre foundation tree
recommendation.emptyDescription: Describe the creative directions you want to cover; you can build the hierarchy manually, or let the AI generate a draft to adjust.
recommendation.describeDescription: Clarifying the work's positioning, reader expectations and core conflict helps the AI understand this genre more accurately when starting and planning a book.
recommendation.readyTitle: Genre foundations are ready to support book setup
recommendation.readyDescription: Every existing genre has a clear description. When you need to cover a new creative direction, add a root genre or a sub-category.

section.title: Genre structure
section.description: Expand detailed directions from the left catalog, then review positioning and maintain nodes on the right. A category in use by a novel can only be deleted after adjusting the linked works.
section.loadingDescription: Please wait, genre-to-novel links are syncing.
section.errorTitle: Genre foundations cannot be loaded right now
section.errorDescription: Please check the service connection and reload. Existing genres are not affected.
section.emptyTitle: No genre foundation available to choose when starting a book
section.emptyDescription: Create a main genre first. You can fill it in manually, or describe a creative direction and let the AI generate a draft genre tree with sub-categories.

createDialog.title: New genre foundation tree
createDialog.description: First set the parent position, then fill in the structure manually or let the AI generate a draft. This maintains the work's genre foundation, i.e. “what kind of book is this”.
createDialog.aiSectionHint: Good for laying out the major groups, sub-groups and lower-level genre foundations together, then fine-tuning manually.
createDialog.promptPlaceholder: Example: I want a female-oriented urban supernatural growth arc; the core selling points are identity reversals, faction management and high-emotion relationship tension.
createDialog.parentNone: No parent, create as a root genre foundation

editDialog.title: Edit genre foundation
editDialog.description: You can change the name, description and mount position. Child nodes and bound novels are kept.
editDialog.parentNone: No parent, as a root genre foundation

browser.navigatorHint: Click a node to see details
browser.deleteBlockedTitle: This genre or a sub-genre is still used by novels; adjust the linked works first.
browser.descriptionFallback: It has not been explained which readers this genre targets or what experience it promises. Once described, the AI can use it more accurately when starting and planning a book.

treeEditor.rootHint: This is the root node that will ultimately be created in the system.
treeEditor.childHint: This will be saved as a child node of the parent type.
treeEditor.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe this type's genre core, payoff moments, common main lines or reader expectations.

treeItem.descriptionFallback: The genre positioning has not been described; consider adding reader expectations and the core creative direction.
treeItem.deleteBlockedTitle: This category or a sub-category is still used by novels; adjust the linked novels' genres first.
